title: Just Modded Vanilla
description: Many worldgen improvements and better structures
body: Just Modded Vanilla is a Vanilla modpack that allows you to play just regular minecraft or have the chance to use the datapacks. The datapacks will improve minecraft's overworld and nether generation. If you Copy paste the datapacks in the world folder and play then you will have all sorts of fun. The datapacks will masivly improve sturctures and dimensions. For example you take an old borring village, you load in the datapacks then the village is way better and bigger. hope you guys enjoy!!!
